8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8"""
g=[[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in rows.strip().split('\n')]
H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
# find 0-regions via flood fill
import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
regions=[]
from collections import deque
for i in range(H):
    for j in range(W):
        if g[i][j]==0 and not seen[i][j]:
            q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==0 and not seen[ny][nx]:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
            ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
            regions.append((min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)))
out=[r[:] for r in g]
for (r0,r1,c0,c1) in regions:
    h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    # seed cells: nonzero cells within region
    seeds=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1) if g[i][j]!=0]
    col=seeds[0][2]
    ys=[s[0] for s in seeds]; xs=[s[1] for s in seeds]
    sy0,sy1,sx0,sx1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
    sh,sw=sy1-sy0+1,sx1-sx0+1
    # determine anchor: seed at a corner; tile by mapping region coords modulo seed size, aligned to anchor
    # offsets from anchor corner
    if sy0==r0: ry=sy0
    else: ry=sy0-(sh*((sy0-r0)//sh+1))  # align upward
    # simpler: anchor offset
    oy=sy0-r0; ox=sx0-c0
    # tile such that pattern period sh,sw; position of seed block top-left in region coords
    # choose block starts so that seed block is one of them
    # block start rows: b such that b <= oy < b+sh... but tiling from anchor edge
    def blocks(oy,size,length):
        # returns list of start offsets so one block starts at oy (anchored side)
        if oy==0: starts=list(range(0,length,size))
        elif oy+size==length: starts=list(range(length-size,-1,-size))
        else: raise ValueError
        return starts
    rs=blocks(oy,sh,h); cs=blocks(ox,sw,w)
    for br in rs:
        for bc in cs:
            for i in range(sh):
                for j in range(sw):
                    out[r0+br+i][c0+bc+j]=g[sy0+i][sx0+j]
print(regions)
for r in out: print(' '.join(map(str,r)))
